nodes.characterization_summary: XRD patterns of Ni₃Sn₂-NiSnOₓ-m show diffraction peaks indexed to Ni and broadened low-intensity peaks at 30.4°, 42.9° and 44.1° for (121), (122) and (320) planes of Ni₃Sn₂ (JCPDS No. 65-9650), indicating successful fabrication of Ni₃Sn₂; Ni-NiOₓ shows only metallic Ni peaks.
nodes.evidence_snippet: X-ray diffraction (XRD) pattern of Ni - NiOₓ only exhibits diffraction peaks indexed to the typical metallic Ni (Figure 2a and Figure S6). As for Ni₃Sn₂-NiSnOₓ-m electrodes, besides those indexed to Ni, relatively broadened and low-intensity diffraction peaks at 30.4°, 42.9° and 44.1° are mainly observed (Figure 2a), which were indexed to the (121), (122) and (320) planes of Ni₃Sn₂ (JCPDS No. 65-9650)

nodes.characterization_summary: Raman spectrum of Ni-NiOₓ shows peaks at 482, 533, 806, 912 and 1023 cm⁻¹ indicating NiO; Ni₃Sn₂-NiSnOₓ-m shows peaks at 482, 806, 912 and 1057 cm⁻¹ indicating coexistence of Ni-O (NiO) and Sn-O (SnOₓ) species in bimetallic oxide NiSnOₓ; relative NiSnOₓ content decreases with increasing Sn/Ni ratio.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Raman spectrum showed that peaks appeared at 482, 533, 806, 912 and 1023 cm⁻¹ for Ni - NiOₓ sample, indicating the formation of NiO in the Ni - NiOₓ ... Raman peaks centered at 482, 806, 912 and 1057 cm⁻¹ were observed, which indicate the coexistence of Ni-O species of NiO and Sn-O species of SnOₓ (Figure S8b) in the bimetallic oxide of NiSnOₓ

nodes.characterization_summary: AC-HRTEM shows crystalline Ni₃Sn₂ NPs with lattice spacings of 0.205, 0.208, 0.210, 0.226, 0.243, and 0.294 nm assigned to (320), (311), (122), (310), (031) and (121) facets of Ni₃Sn₂ and amorphous NiSnOₓ domains; Ni₃Sn₂-NiSnOₓ-2 has smallest NPs with average diameter ca. 2.1 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The observed lattice fringe spacings of 0.205, 0.208, 0.210, 0.226, 0.243, and 0.294 nm for the Ni₃Sn₂-NiSnOₓ-2 could be assigned to (320), (311), (122), (310), (031) and (121) facets of Ni₃Sn₂, respectively ... the Ni₃Sn₂-NiSnOₓ-2 exhibits the smallest Ni₃Sn₂ NPs with average diameters of ca. 2.1 nm

nodes.characterization_summary: SAED pattern confirms polycrystalline domains of Ni₃Sn₂ NPs with highly diffused halo assigned to amorphous NiSnOₓ component.
nodes.evidence_snippet: These results collectively manifest the polycrystalline domains of Ni₃Sn₂ NPs with different crystal planes, which is further confirmed by the selected-area electron diffraction (SAED) pattern ... A highly diffused halo appeared on the SAED pattern, which is assigned to amorphous NiSnOₓ component.

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM image and EDS mappings reveal clearly defined Ni₃Sn₂-NiSnOₓ nanocomposites with uniform distribution of Ni, Sn and O.
nodes.evidence_snippet: High-angle annular darkfield scanning transmission electron microscopic (HAADFSTEM) image and the EDS mappings further revealed the clearly defined Ni₃Sn₂-NiSnOₓ nanocomposites for Ni₃Sn₂-NiSnOₓ-2 catalyst.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS Ni 2p and Sn 3d spectra show coexistence of metallic (Ni⁰, Sn⁰) and oxidized (Ni²⁺, Sn²⁺/⁴⁺) states; Ni 2p BEs shifted +0.64 eV and Sn 3d -1.07 eV vs Ni-NiOₓ and Sn-SnOₓ indicate strong Ni-Sn electronic interaction; Ni⁰/Sn⁰ ratio ≈1.6 matches Ni₃Sn₂ stoichiometry; metallic state contributions vary systematically with Sn/Ni ratio.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The XPS spectra of Ni₃Sn₂-NiSnOₓ-2 showed that the surface of the catalyst is composed of Ni, Sn, and O elements, and the Ni and Sn are all in complex states corresponding to metallic state (Ni⁰ and Sn⁰) and oxidative state (Ni²⁺ and Sn²⁺/⁴⁺) ... the binding energies (BEs) of Ni 2p and Sn 3d of the Ni₃Sn₂-NiSnOₓ-2 catalyst are positively and negatively shifted by ca. 0.64 and 1.07 eV, respectively ... the Ni⁰/Sn⁰ ratio of the sample is estimated to be ca. 1.6

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS analysis and mapping demonstrate uniform distribution of Ni, Sn and O throughout measured regions of Ni₃Sn₂-NiSnOₓ-m catalysts.
nodes.evidence_snippet: To examine the elemental composition and distribution in Ni₃Sn₂-NiSnOₓ-m catalysts, energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDS) analysis and EDS mapping images were collected, which demonstrated the uniformly distribution of Ni, Sn and O throughout the measured regions

nodes.characterization_summary: ICP-MS during HER stability test shows Sn ions slight dissolution initially then stabilizing after ~40 h; final dissolved Ni and Sn concentrations <0.07 and 0.58 μmol L⁻¹.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Inductively coupled plasma mass spectrometry (ICP-MS) showed that Sn ions experienced a very slight dissolution at the beginning of electrolysis, stabilizing after ca. 40 h, and the Ni and Sn cations in the solution were only < 0.07 and 0.58 μmol L⁻¹ after the test (Figure 3f).
